Also "对非国家工作人员行贿" would be the customers bribing staff, but the prosecution is against staff for receiving bribes. So charge: 非国家工作人员受贿.

Check if any other crimes: maybe "利用影响力受贿"? That's for using influence. Not here. So single charge.

Thus final answer: [罪名]非国家工作人员受贿<eoa>
